description_en: Queries task statistics in the task center
name: DescribeHistoryTasksStat

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Scheduled: Pending execution.

Running: Running.

Succeed: Succeeded.

Failed: Failed.

Cancelling: Cancelling.

Canceled: Canceled.

Waiting: Waiting for the scheduled time.

Separate multiple values with commas (,). By default, this parameter is left empty, which indicates that all statuses are queried
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，取值说明：

Scheduled：等待执行。

Running：执行中。

Succeed：执行成功。

Failed：执行失败。

Cancelling：正在终止。

Canceled：已终止。

Waiting：等待预设时间。

如有多个状态则用英文逗号分隔，默认为空，表示全选
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: from_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Only tasks whose start time is earlier than the specified end time are returned. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，表示仅返回任务开始时间早于该时间的任务；采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: to_start_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum execution duration of the task, in seconds. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is greater than the specified value. Default value: 0, which indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最小值，用于筛选任务执行耗时大于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认 0，表示不限制
parameters.name: from_exec_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum execution duration of the task, in seconds. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is less than or equal to the specified value. Default value: 0, which indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最大值，用于筛选任务执行耗时不小于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认 0，表示不限制
parameters.name: to_exec_time

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The display name of the authorized principal

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the authenticated principal

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The type of the authorized principal

NoPermissionType.description_en:
The type of the access policy denial. Valid values:
ImplicitDeny: The resource owner has not configured a relevant access policy for the current user, and unauthorized operations are denied by default.
ExplicitDeny: The RAM policy configured by the resource owner explicitly denies the current user access to the corresponding resource
NoPermissionType.description_zh:
权限策略拒绝的类型，取值如下：
ImplicitDeny：资源持有者未配置相关权限策略给当前用户，缺省拒绝未授权的操作。
ExplicitDeny：资源持有者配置的RAM策略明确拒绝了当前用户访问对应的资源

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the policy that caused the permission denial. Valid values:
ControlPolicy: Control policy.
SessionPolicy: An additional permission policy added to the temporary token.
AssumeRolePolicy: The trust policy of the RAM role.
AccountLevelIdentityBasedPolicy: The identity-access policy at the account level, including custom policies and system policies.
ResourceGroupLevelIdentityBasedPolicy: The identity-access policy at the resource group level, including custom policies and system policies
PolicyType.description_zh:
引起无权限的策略类型，取值如下:
ControlPolicy ：管控策略。
SessionPolicy：临时Token额外添加的一个权限策略。
AssumeRolePolicy：RAM角色的授信策略。
AccountLevelIdentityBasedPolicy：账号授权范围的主体策略，包含自定义策略和系统策略。
ResourceGroupLevelIdentityBasedPolicy：资源组授权范围的主体策略，包含自定义策略和系统策略
